title: Reel: three questions for any AI ad advice (meet Vira)
hook: An AI tool says cut this ad. Ask it three questions first.
caption:
An AI tool says cut this ad. Ask it three questions first.

1. What did you look at? Which ads, which dates?
2. What would you do: scale, cut or shift?
3. What result would prove you wrong?

If a tool can't answer, treat the advice as a guess.

Vira, Galvor's digital co-worker, shows its thinking with every call, so your team can check it before anyone acts. See Vira on galvor.ai, link in bio. Follow @galvor.ai.

script.setup: Idea: a head of growth who is being offered AI recommendations on which ads to scale or cut, and is ready to try one, gets three questions that separate advice from guesses, then meets Vira. On-screen title: Before you trust AI ad advice. Expectation set: a caution about AI. The script beats it with a usable test and a product that is built to pass it. Outline: what did you look at; what would you do (second-best, first); what would prove you wrong (best); Vira shows its thinking.

scenes.visual: A chat bubble on a dashboard says: cut this ad. A cursor hovers over a confirm button.
scenes.voiceover: AI tools now tell you which ads to scale and cut.
scenes.on_screen: Before you trust AI ad advice

scenes.visual: The confirm button pauses. A magnifying glass moves over the chat bubble.
scenes.voiceover: Most teams check if the advice sounds right. Check its working.

scenes.visual: Question one appears. Dummy ad tiles and a date range light up behind it.
scenes.voiceover: Question one: what did you look at? Which ads, which dates?

scenes.visual: Question two appears. Three buttons: scale, cut, shift.
scenes.voiceover: Question two: what would you do? Scale, cut or shift?

scenes.visual: The first two questions tick themselves. The third card stays face down and glows.
scenes.voiceover: Those two are easy. The third one sorts advice from guesses.
Question three: what result would prove you wrong?

scenes.visual: The name Vira appears with a short reasoning panel opening beside a recommendation.
scenes.voiceover: Vira, Galvor's digital co-worker, shows its thinking with every call.

scenes.visual: A person icon reads the panel, then presses the button.
scenes.voiceover: Advice you can check is advice you can act on.

scenes.visual: End card with the Galvor logo, the word Vira and a link-in-bio arrow. Chime.
scenes.voiceover: See Vira, link in bio. Follow @galvor.ai.

script.music: Light instrumental bed, low under the voice. Soft chime on the end card only.
script.notes: AI voiceover over motion graphics. No presenter and no first person singular. Captions burned in for muted viewing. Use dummy ad tiles only, never a client account or name. No numbers used. Scene 7 must use a real Vira screen or a faithful redraw approved by the product team. Do not mock up a feature that does not exist.
